capabilities: hand write between paragraphs with a stylus or Apple pencil
draw sketches and diagrams inline in notes
write math equations and scientific notation by hand
draw on an infinite canvas powered by tldraw
extras: README links to a demo video and developer devlogs rather than embedding content; beta versions can be installed via the BRAT plugin, with new features taking days to a month to reach the standard release.
problem: Obsidian notes are text-only, so there is no built-in way to hand write or draw with a pen between paragraphs of a note.

relations.evidence: Runs on the tldraw framework and drawing provides an infinite canvas.

summary: Stylus drawing plugin that lets you hand write or sketch directly between paragraphs in notes, running on the tldraw framework with an infinite canvas.
